title: Devcontainer agent toolchain and hook wiring
summary: This change turns the devcontainer image from a Rust-only build box into a full agent factory: it pins and checksum-verifies Node, pnpm, Bun, moon, gh, actionlint, uv, SkillSpector/SkillEvaluator and four coding agents (codex, claude-code, opencode, omp), builds the dsh/omp/opencode writing-check plugins from the workspace lockfile, and installs each agent's hook files root-owned and read-only so `osf hook` fires on prompt and stop. The git wrapper now forces the hooks path per-invocation under the workspace mount instead of a system-wide core.hooksPath, and a battery of build-time tests proves the wrapper's refusals, the hook wiring, the toolchain read-only-ness and a clean image.

nodes.label: devcontainer.json
nodes.subtitle: workspaceMount + remoteEnv
nodes.summary: Now binds the repository at /workspace explicitly, forwards GH_TOKEN from the host environment, and its postCreateCommand checks osf, moon, node and pnpm and reports the hooks path.

nodes.label: Dockerfile
nodes.subtitle: +493 lines of pinned installs
nodes.summary: The single build recipe. Adds checksum-verified downloads for moon, gh, actionlint, uv, Node, Bun; installs the four coding agents as global npm packages; builds the dsh/omp/opencode plugins from the workspace lockfile; installs hook files and the git wrapper root-owned and read-only; and runs eight build-time test scripts.

nodes.label: Pinned tool downloads
nodes.subtitle: sha256-verified release tarballs
nodes.summary: moon, gh, actionlint, uv, Node 22, Bun and git-town, each fetched per TARGETARCH and checked against a published SHA-256 before install.

nodes.label: Coding agents
nodes.subtitle: codex, claude-code, opencode, omp
nodes.summary: Four agents installed as global npm packages at exact pinned versions into the root-owned Node install, with write bits stripped afterwards.

nodes.label: SkillSpector / SkillEvaluator
nodes.subtitle: uv tool install at pinned commits
nodes.summary: The two NVIDIA skill-checking tools, installed from git at full 40-character commits with UV_TOOL_DIR and UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR moved out of root's home so dev can read and execute them.

nodes.label: Plugin build stage
nodes.subtitle: pnpm --filter dsh omp opencode
nodes.summary: A separate build stage copies package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and the apps/packages/integrations trees, runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, and builds the three writing-check integrations so their dist/ matches what CI already tests.

nodes.label: osf build stage
nodes.subtitle: cargo build --release --bin osf
nodes.summary: Unchanged in substance; now uses cargo registry and git cache mounts, and the resulting binary is installed root-owned and read-only at /opt/factory/bin/osf.

nodes.label: Agent hook files
nodes.subtitle: root-owned, mode 0444
nodes.summary: Codex's /etc/codex config and requirements plus its managed hooks dir, and the home-level hook files written by `osf hooks install --agents`, then chowned root and made read-only; the claude and opencode copies are mirrored to /etc/claude-code and /etc/opencode.

nodes.label: dsh profiles
nodes.subtitle: factory and headless
nodes.summary: Both dsh profiles get the osf-dsh-plugin under node_modules plus a cordis.patch.yml registering it and the Claude-format hooks bridge pointed at the repo's own .claude/hooks.json; only cordis.yml stays dev-owned because dsh rewrites it on start.

nodes.label: .claude/hooks.json
nodes.subtitle: UserPromptSubmit -> osf hook prompt
nodes.summary: The repository's own Claude-format hook file, referenced by the dsh profiles' hooks bridge rather than copied under the root-owned profile directory.

nodes.label: git wrapper
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/bin/git
nodes.summary: Refuses --no-verify and -n on commit and --no-verify on push, then forces core.hooksPath=/opt/factory/githooks on the command line for every git call under OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT, so a scratch repo under /tmp is unaffected.

nodes.label: git hooks
nodes.subtitle: pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push
nodes.summary: Root-owned, mode 0555 scripts that each call osf; unchanged in content, but now reached through the wrapper's forced hooks path rather than a system-wide config.

nodes.label: osf-path.sh
nodes.subtitle: /etc/profile.d
nodes.summary: Restores PATH after a login shell resets it, so osf, the cargo toolchain and every agent binary stay reachable.

nodes.label: Build-time tests
nodes.subtitle: 8 scripts run during docker build
nodes.summary: git-wrapper, git-hooks, agent-hooks, coding-agent-tools, builder-tools, dsh-starts, skills-installed, toolchain-readonly and image-clean each run inside the build so a broken wrapper, hook or permission fails the image instead of shipping.

nodes.label: dev user
nodes.subtitle: non-root, no sudo
nodes.summary: The container user. Owns its own CARGO_HOME and the writable cordis.yml files, but cannot replace rustc, cargo, osf, the wrapper or any hook file.

nodes.label: /workspace
nodes.subtitle: bind-mounted repository
nodes.summary: The bind mount named by both devcontainer.json and OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT; the wrapper treats only repositories under this path as subject to the forced hooks path.

nodes.label: osf
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/bin/osf
nodes.summary: The factory CLI. Its `hook prompt` and `hook stop` subcommands are what every agent's hook file invokes, and `hooks install --agents` is what wrote those files at build time.

nodes.label: Agent process
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode / omp / dsh
nodes.summary: Whichever agent the developer launches. On prompt submit and on stop it shells out to `osf hook`, which is the only hook event osf supports; no pre-tool-use event is wired.

nodes.label: osf-dsh-plugin
nodes.subtitle: integrations/dsh
nodes.summary: The dsh writing-check plugin, built from the workspace lockfile and copied into both dsh profiles' node_modules; its index.ts gained a small change in this diff.

nodes.label: npm registry
nodes.subtitle: registry.npmjs.org
nodes.summary: Source of the four coding agents and of dsh's own dependency tree, pinned by exact version and by .devcontainer/dsh/package-lock.json.

nodes.label: Release hosts
nodes.subtitle: github.com, nodejs.org
nodes.summary: Where the pinned tool tarballs come from; every download is verified against a SHA-256 baked into the Dockerfile.

nodes.label: Model APIs
nodes.subtitle: agent inference endpoints
nodes.summary: Where the coding agents send their inference traffic; the image only supplies the binaries and the hook wiring, not credentials.

nodes.label: devcontainer-image workflow
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows
nodes.summary: A new GitHub Actions workflow that builds the devcontainer image, so the same build-time tests run in CI as well as locally.
